title: Suite
description: evals/suites/<name>.yaml. A named set of tasks with one job: regression stays near 100%, capability is the hill to climb, quality uses trusted judges only.

name.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

gate.description: Overrides the gate in litmustest.yaml for this suite.

path_checks.description: Whether transcript checks count. Defaults to true for regression and quality, false for capability.

graduated_from.description: For a regression suite seeded from a saturated capability suite.
